data.revised_prompt:
Edit the provided scientific method figure (keep polished SCI journal style, all existing thumbnails/icons/wall-depth/washout/blur/noise/edge visuals preserved). Make ONLY the requested data-flow corrections for the forward active-depth sensor model; no gradients, no loss box, no red arrows, no dashed gradient paths, no new generic icons.

Global style: preserve the current color palette, rounded module boxes, thin teal outlines, orange/red output panels, and readable journal-figure typography. Keep the title and overall layout similar.

LEFT-SIDE CORRECTIONS:
- Remove any arrowhead touching the left side of the “Camera registers c=[P,E,G]” box.
- Remove any arrows from the active stereo sketch into the camera-register box.
- Remove any arrows from raw depth D_raw into the camera-register box.
- Remove any arrows from scene mask Omega into the camera-register box.
- Camera registers c=[P,E,G] should have outgoing arrows only, feeding the S_phi factor rows.
- Route D_raw and Omega as independent geometry/context inputs into S_phi using clean elbow arrows that go around the camera-register box and terminate at the left edge of S_phi.
- Draw speed ||v_t|| as a small context input into the motion blur row only.

INSIDE S_phi:
- Show five factor rows with these exact dependencies and labels:
  1 active return: (P, D_raw)
  2 ambient washout: (E, Omega)
  3 motion blur: (E, ||v_t||)
  4 gain/noise: (G)
  5 edge difficulty: (D_raw)
- All five rows should visually merge into “quality Q” using a bracket/common combiner line on the right of the five rows, then a single arrow to quality Q.
- Keep the existing pictorial thumbnails for each row.

RIGHT-SIDE CORRECTIONS:
- Do not show quality Q directly producing D_obs.
- Use the composition:
  Q -> soft validity M -> straight-through mask M_ST
  M_ST feeds both observed outputs
  D_obs = D_raw x M_ST
  Q_obs = Q x M_ST
- Draw thin gray bypass arrows from D_raw toward D_obs and from Q toward Q_obs if needed, but the main gate feeding both outputs must be M_ST.
- Keep the output panels for observed depth D_obs and observed quality Q_obs.

TEXT TO KEEP EXACTLY:
- “Omega in [0,1]: scene/material mask”
- “M = sigmoid((Q - q0) / sigma_q)”
- “Q = clip(Q0 + Omega C_rho, 0,1)”
- “D_obs = D_raw x M_ST”
- “Q_obs = Q x M_ST”

Do not add extra explanatory text. Keep labels aligned and readable for a top SCI/CS journal figure. Ensure all arrows have clear arrowheads and terminate on the correct module.
